chapter: Sidemen, the Hampton years, race and money
title: The unpublished portion of Beneath the Underdog
summary: Mingus wants Sue to edit the cut material about record-company theft and Debut sales.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: Are you going to issue the rest of your book? I know they told me one time that you thought that you'd like to put out the part that they cut out of the first book.
If I can give it to Sue and I'd like to edit it. Sue to do it, if I can find it, for one thing.
It was a book told a whole lot about

theft, about the record companies and all that. How I sold records for Debut Records, and they never sold as many as I did myself. Some of the things we're talking about now with Sy. That's why that book will be interesting.
